# fmc_access_control_policy_advanced_logging (Resource)

This resource manages Access Control Policy Advanced Logging Settings.

The following restrictions apply:
  - Minimum FMC version: `10.0`

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "fmc_access_control_policy_advanced_logging" "example" {
  access_control_policy_id  = "76d24097-41c4-4558-a4d0-a8c07ac08470"
  enabled                   = true
  log_format                = "CSV"
  send_to_other_destination = true
  send_to_splunk            = true
  syslog_alert_id           = "35e197ca-33a8-11ef-b2d1-d98ae17766e7"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `access_control_policy_id` (String) Id of the Access Control Policy.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable advanced logging.
- `log_format` (String) Format of the advanced logging events.
  - Choices: `JSON`, `CSV`, `TSV`

### Optional

- `domain` (String) Name of the FMC domain
- `send_to_other_destination` (Boolean) Send events to a destination other than the one configured in Access Control Policy logging settings.
- `send_to_splunk` (Boolean) Send events to all configured Splunk profiles. Can be set only when `send_to_other_destination` is true.
- `syslog_alert_id` (String) Id of the syslog alert to send events to. Can be set only when `send_to_other_destination` is true.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Id of the object
- `type` (String) Type of the object; this value is always 'AdvancedLoggingSetting'.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <domain> is optional. If not provided, `Global` is used implicitly and resource's `domain` attribute is not set.
terraform import fmc_access_control_policy_advanced_logging.example "<domain>,<access_control_policy_id>,<id>"
```
